oto.sektor: bir sanayi sitesinde oto tamirci dükkânı
oto.esnaf_tarif: Turkish car mechanic in his 40s, oil-stained dark-blue overalls, a wrench in hand, short curly black hair, thick black mustache, grease smudge on his cheek
oto.fikir: Levent'in arabası tuhaf bir ses çıkarır, tamirciye taklidini yapar. Tamirci ciddi ciddi dinleyip teşhis koyar. Punchline: ses aslında bagajda uyuyan Cemo'nun horlamasıdır.
oto.notlar: Bu skeçte sponsor/reklam yok; sadece temiz mizah.

senaryo.aciklama: Tamirci arızayı buldu 😂 Sizin arabadan hangi ses geliyor?

planlar.metin: [excited] Usta, arabadan böyle bir ses geliyor: hırrr... fışşş!
planlar.gorsel: A car repair garage in a Bursa industrial area, Levent next to a small red car imitating a sound with his hands, the mechanic seen from behind.

planlar.metin: Hmm. Motor mu, şanzıman mı? Bir daha yap bakalım.
planlar.gorsel: Same garage, the mechanic holding a wrench and thinking, Levent seen from behind.
Same garage, Levent with puffed cheeks making the noise dramatically, the mechanic seen from behind.

planlar.metin: Bu ses bana tanıdık geliyor... bagajı açalım.
planlar.gorsel: Same garage, the mechanic walking toward the back of the small red car, Levent seen from behind.

Same garage, the open trunk of the small red car seen from behind the car. Curled up asleep INSIDE the trunk is Cemo (the ONLY Cemo in the picture; nobody with a cap or green jacket stands anywhere else), hugging a sandwich. Levent and the mechanic stand next to the car looking into the trunk, both seen from behind. No signs or text.
planlar.hareket: Cemo sleeps inside the trunk hugging a sandwich, his chest rising as he snores, Levent and the mechanic lean in surprised
planlar.efekt: car trunk opening then loud snoring

planlar.gorsel: Close-up from above of Cemo lying inside the car trunk, just woken up, rubbing his eyes, hugging a sandwich. Only the trunk interior and the garage ceiling are visible; NO other person in the frame. No signs or text.
